text:
Case note: Com. S. No. 2624/2025
Client: Sunanda Banerjee (civil engineer, Ahmedabad)
Opposing party: Lotus Industries
Court: Ahmedabad Commercial Court
Filed on: 31 August 2025
Claim amount: ₹3.5 crore
Issue: breach of contract. The counterparty has not paid the invoices for delivered goods.
Advice given: Invoke the arbitration clause and seek interim relief to secure the amount.
Outcome: The tribunal ordered a deposit of the disputed amount.
Recommended next step: Proceed with the arbitration.
Witness: Swati Goyal
Matter code: Project Pelican
